verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for an API-first speech-to-text service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The docs cover only transcription features, limits and SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
